# Fuzz targets (spec §10.2 #7, FR-D5; cc N2). The portable driver replays tests/fixtures/corpus/<target>/ and
# runs seeded mutations through each entry point; run it under the gcc16-asan-ubsan preset for real coverage.
# Seed corpora and negative fixtures are regenerated by `runtime_selftest <out.ser> <fixtures-dir>` (tests/fixtures);
# runtime_selftest asserts the checked-in negative fixtures byte-for-byte.
option(ES_SERREG_LIBFUZZER "Also build libFuzzer executables (clang, -fsanitize=fuzzer)" OFF)

add_executable(serreg_fuzz fuzz_driver.cpp fuzz_targets.cpp)
target_link_libraries(serreg_fuzz PRIVATE es::serreg_tools) # the config target fuzzes the CLI's TOML parser
target_include_directories(serreg_fuzz PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../golden) # corpus.hpp (typed readers)
es_serreg_apply_warnings(serreg_fuzz)

set(ES_SERREG_FUZZ_ITERATIONS 300 CACHE STRING "Mutations per corpus file in the ctest fuzz runs")
foreach(t rri capture elf config)
  add_test(NAME fuzz_${t} COMMAND serreg_fuzz ${t} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../fixtures/corpus/${t} ${ES_SERREG_FUZZ_ITERATIONS} 1)
  set_tests_properties(fuzz_${t} PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "^fuzz ${t}: " TIMEOUT 600)
endforeach()

if(ES_SERREG_LIBFUZZER)
  foreach(t rri capture elf config)
    add_executable(serreg_libfuzz_${t} fuzz_targets.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(serreg_libfuzz_${t} PRIVATE es::serreg_tools)
    target_include_directories(serreg_libfuzz_${t} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../golden)
    target_compile_definitions(serreg_libfuzz_${t} PRIVATE ES_SERREG_LIBFUZZER=1 ES_SERREG_FUZZ_TARGET=fuzz_${t})
    target_compile_options(serreg_libfuzz_${t} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined)
    target_link_options(serreg_libfuzz_${t} PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined)
  endforeach()
endif()
